question: Find the average number of oxygen atoms in carcinogenic molecules that contain at least one bond between a nitrogen atom and a phosphorus atom.

prediction.sql:
SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) FROM (
  SELECT m.XCL_010, COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS oxygen_count
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN atom a ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
  WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+'
    AND a.XCL_003 = 'o'
    AND m.XCL_010 IN (
      SELECT b.XCL_005
      FROM bond b
      JOIN connected c ON c.XCL_009 = b.XCL_004
      JOIN atom a1 ON a1.XCL_001 = c.XCL_007
      JOIN atom a2 ON a2.XCL_001 = c.XCL_008
      WHERE (a1.XCL_003 = 'n' AND a2.XCL_003 = 'p')
         OR (a1.XCL_003 = 'p' AND a2.XCL_003 = 'n')
    )
  GROUP BY m.XCL_010
)
